 OLX shall list the Products on the Website at the Price of the relevant Product . The Price shall not be higher than the price at which the Seller offers the same Product through its own sales channels. 
 
 The Website shall show the Product as being sold by the Seller and not by OLX. Listing of the Products on the Website does not, in any manner, imply that OLX is selling, warranting, endorsing or is affiliated with the Seller or the Seller’s Products.

 PRODUCT INVENTORY 
 
 The Seller must ensure that all Products comply with the applicable product category requirements, such as quality, quantity , description and Seller Inventory requirements, prescribed by OLX, as amended from time to time at OLX’s sole discretion.

 The Seller must ensure that all Products will be free of any claim, charge, mortgage, lien, hypothecation or any other security interest of any nature whatsoever . 
 Any Product which OLX, in its sole discretion, decides to stop featuring on the Website will be removed from the Website and , under the ‘Fulfilled by OLX’ Fulfillment Model , will be returned to the Seller. 
 
 Where the Fulfillment Model is Fulfilled by OLX , in the event of any loss, shrinkage or damage to the Products as a direct result of an act, error or omission of OLX solely then OLX’s liability shall be limited to the maximum extent of the cost of such Products when they were first delivered to OLX’s warehouse and accepted by OLX.
